continuum.Hilbert_space: L2 of the dimensionless circle R/(12Z)
continuum.Fourier_eigenvalues: mu_k=1+(pi k/6)^2 for k in Z

discrete_comparison.space: C^N with B_N=h I inner product
discrete_comparison.embedding: I_N sends mass-normalized discrete Fourier modes to continuum Fourier modes with |k|<N/2, with the Nyquist convention fixed at even N
discrete_comparison.projection: I_N^* is Fourier truncation followed by discrete synthesis

resolvent.continuum: R=(-1-A)^-1 equivalently -(A+1)^-1; sign is irrelevant to norm error
resolvent.extended_discrete: R_N=I_N (A_N+1)^-1 I_N^* with zero action on omitted Fourier modes
resolvent.exact_error: maximum of represented-mode reciprocal-eigenvalue discrepancies and the first omitted continuum reciprocal eigenvalue
resolvent.convergence: operator norm error tends to zero

symmetry.Real: complex conjugation sends Fourier k to -k and commutes with both resolvents
symmetry.orientation: circle reflection sends k to -k and commutes with both resolvents

source_blocker.first_missing_object: source-derived comparison from the diagonal-shell/all-jet carrier to this periodic L2 circle operator
source_blocker.acceptance: declare the source Hilbert topology, operator domain, trace embedding, and prove that the source response intertwines with 1-partial_x^2 or replace this synthetic continuum target
